# Filemark — Full AI Context

One-stop brief for any new AI session working on filemark. Skim this
before anything else. Cross-refs the deeper docs; duplication is
intentional so each section stands alone.

- **Last updated:** 2026-04-23
- **Audience:** AI agents + future-me starting cold
- **Scope:** enough to understand the repo, decisions, and open work
  without hunting

---

## 1. Identity

- **Project:** filemark — a Chrome extension (MV3) that renders
  `.md`, `.mdx`, `.json`, `.jsonc`, `.sql`, `.prisma`, `.dbml` locally
  with first-class interactive features.
- **Scope framing:** personal power-tool for the author. Not a
  collaboration platform; not a cloud product. Local-first, MV3-native,
  zero tracking.
- **Unique selling point:** markdown is programmable — fenced `csv`
  blocks become sortable/filterable/groupable/exportable datagrids;
  task checkboxes persist; ER diagrams render inline; all without any
  JavaScript evaluation (MV3 CSP compliant).

---

## 2. Where the code lives

| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Actual code** | `/Volumes/D/www/projects/khanakia/chrome-extensions/filemark/` |
| Private docs + CLAUDE.md (source of truth) | `/Volumes/D/www/projects/khanakia/private-repo/markdown-viewer-chrome-ext/` |
| Those private docs symlinked into code repo via `repolink` | `filemark/CLAUDE.md` and `filemark/docsi/` |

The docs cwd contains **no code** — only planning / rules / problem
docs. Code edits belong in `filemark/`. A repolink-managed block in
`filemark/.gitignore` keeps the symlinks out of git history.

**Heuristic for new sessions:** if the cwd has no `package.json`,
you're in the docs dir; the code is in `chrome-extensions/filemark/`.

---

## 3. Tech stack

| Concern | Pick |
|---|---|
| Build system | pnpm workspaces · tsup (packages) · Vite 6 (app) · CRXJS |
| Language | TypeScript 5.7 |
| UI | React 19 · Tailwind CSS v4 · shadcn / basecn primitives |
| Markdown | `react-markdown` (chosen over `@mdx-js/mdx` — see §5 CSP) + remark-gfm / remark-math / remark-breaks + rehype-raw / rehype-slug / rehype-katex |
| Code highlight | Shiki (core + JS regex engine, lazy per-language) |
| JSON tree | `@uiw/react-json-view` |
| Table | `@tanstack/react-table` + `@tanstack/react-virtual` + `papaparse` |
| Diagrams | Mermaid (lazy-loaded) |
| Math | KaTeX |
| Search | FlexSearch |
| Storage | `idb-keyval` (IndexedDB) |
| State | zustand |
| Manifest | MV3 with `host_permissions: ["<all_urls>"]` (bypasses CORS for remote CSV) |

---

## 4. Monorepo layout

```
filemark/
├── apps/
│   └── chrome-ext/                 MV3 host (App.tsx, Shell, TopBar, Sidebar, Viewer, …)
│       ├── public/manifest.json    MV3 manifest (storage + <all_urls> + file:// intercept)
│       └── src/app/adapters/       Chrome-specific StorageAdapter, AssetResolver, …
├── packages/
│   ├── viewer-core/                @filemark/core  — shared types + ThemeProvider
│   ├── mdx-viewer/                 @filemark/mdx   — `react-markdown` pipeline + Datagrid wiring
│   ├── json-viewer/                @filemark/json  — tree viewer
│   ├── schema-viewer/              @filemark/schema — SQL/Prisma/DBML → Mermaid ER
│   └── datagrid/                   @filemark/datagrid — TanStack-based grid (centerpiece)
├── examples/                       live-test markdown: datagrid.md, datagrid-full.md, sales.csv
├── CLAUDE.md                       repolink symlink → private-repo
├── docsi/                          repolink symlink → private-repo (planning docs + this file)
├── README.md                       public-facing
├── Taskfile.yml                    task runner
└── pnpm-workspace.yaml
```

---

## 5. The CSP constraint (why `react-markdown`, not `@mdx-js/mdx`)

MV3 extension pages default to `script-src 'self'; object-src 'self';`
and **cannot** add `'unsafe-eval'` via manifest (allowlist for MV3
extension_pages is `'self' | 'none' | 'wasm-unsafe-eval' | localhost`).
So any runtime compilation path that calls `new Function()` is dead.

- `@mdx-js/mdx`'s `evaluate` / `run` → blocked. So we use
  `react-markdown`, which walks an AST to React elements — zero eval.
- `<Datagrid>`, `<Callout>`, `<Tabs>` etc. are **lowercase HTML tags**
  passed through by `rehype-raw` and mapped to React components via
  `components` prop. HTML attribute values only (no JSX expressions).
- A **sandbox iframe** path (manifest `content_security_policy.sandbox`
  allows `'unsafe-eval'`) is reserved for v0.2+ if we ever want true
  MDX JSX. postMessage bridge, no `chrome.*` inside.

---

## 6. `@filemark/datagrid` — the big one

Single biggest recent investment. Full spec in `docsi/DATAGRID.md`;
quick map here.

### 6.1 Entry points

| Author writes | Parsed by | Renders |
|---|---|---|
| ` ```csv <flags> ` fence | `MDXViewer.components.code` → `DataBlock` → `DataGridFromText` → `DataGrid` | interactive grid |
| ` ```tsv <flags> ` fence | same path, tab delimiter default | same |
| ` ```datagrid <flags> ` fence | same path, explicit opt-in | same |
| `<Datagrid src="…" meta="…" … />` | `MDXViewer.components.datagrid` → `DataBlock` | same, src-only (no inline data) |

A tiny remark plugin `remarkCodeMeta` copies `node.meta` onto hast as
`data-meta`, so the fence's info-string survives to the React layer.

### 6.2 Info-string grammar

Shell-ish whitespace-split tokens, quotes respected, parens group
internal whitespace. Flags include:

- Global: `filter`, `search`, `sort=<col>[:asc|desc]` (comma-separated
  for multi), `hide=<col>,…`, `delimiter=<char>`, `header`, `src=<path>`,
  `height=<px>`, `title=<text>`, `sticky-header`, `row-numbers`,
  `id-column=<col>`, `agg:<col>=<fn>`, `freeze=<col>,…`,
  `density=compact|comfy|relaxed`, `selection`, `group-by=<col>`,
  `expandable`, `url-sync`, `width:<col>=<px>`.
- Per-column: `type:<col>=<type-expr>`, `align:<col>=<left|right|center>`,
  `width:<col>=<px>`.
- Type expressions take optional parens with args, e.g.
  `status(P0:danger,P1:warn)`, `currency(USD)`, `progress(0:100)`,
  `rating(10)`, `tags(|)`, `sparkline(line|bar|area)`, `duration(s|ms|m|h)`,
  `range(<sep>)`.

### 6.3 Column types (25 total)

**Primitives (auto-inferred):** `string`, `number`, `date`, `bool`.

**Status / categorical:** `status`, `tags`, `checkmark`, `checkbox`
(interactive + persisted, requires `id` column), `rating`, `progress`.

**Numeric:** `currency`, `percentage`, `filesize`.

**Identity / links:** `url`, `email`, `phone`, `avatar` (initials or
image), `id`.

**Temporal / text:** `date`, `relative`, `code`.

**Visual:** `color` (hex → swatch), `icon` (15-icon curated set),
`country` (ISO-2 → flag emoji), `sparkline`, `duration`, `range`,
`code-block`, `json`, `image` (absolute URL → thumbnail).

### 6.4 Features shipped (v1 → v2)

- **Core (v1):** sort, per-column filter, global search, column
  resize + double-click-to-fit (canvas-measured), column visibility,
  row virtualization, sticky header, StorageAdapter persistence,
  JSON/MD export of filtered view.
- **v1.1 quick wins:** multi-column sort (shift-click), match
  highlight, density toggle, aggregation footer, row selection + bulk
  copy to clipboard, keyboard nav, pinned columns.
- **v1.2 structural:** row grouping with per-group aggregations,
  typed filter UIs (numeric range / date range / multi-select / bool
  tri-state), row expansion detail panel, URL-sync for shareable
  views.
- **v2 rich types:** `sparkline`, `icon`, `country`, `duration`,
  `range`, `code-block`, `json`, `image`.
- **UX polish:** minimal-icon toolbar with hover reveal, full-screen
  toggle, raw-source toggle (shows authored fence in monospace),
  author-specified column widths, canvas text measurement, persisted
  state versioning (`_v: 2`) so cached narrow widths don't override
  new auto-sizes.

### 6.5 Persistence keys

`filemark:datagrid:<storageKey>` → `{ _v, sorting, columnFilters,
columnVisibility, columnSizing, density, grouping, expanded,
globalFilter }`.

`filemark:datagrid:<storageKey>:cell:<rowId>:<colKey>` → boolean (only
used by interactive `checkbox` cells; `rowId` comes from the `id` column).

`storageKey` = `<fileId>:<lang>:<fnv1a(rawBody + meta)>` — changes
when the block's content or info-string changes.

### 6.6 URL-sync

`url-sync` flag mirrors state into `location.hash#g=<base64-json>`.
Preserves other hash fragments (heading anchors still work). URL wins
over StorageAdapter on hydration so shared links reproduce reliably.

### 6.7 External data + CORS

- Relative `src=./foo.csv` → goes through `AssetResolver.resolve()`.
  Works when opened via FSA folder or dropped folder (with persistent
  handles).
- Absolute `src=https://host/foo.csv` → fetched directly. Manifest
  `host_permissions: ["<all_urls>"]` bypasses CORS (chose Option A
  over `optional_host_permissions` for v0.1 UX; migration plan in
  `docsi/DATAGRID.md` §CORS).

---

## 7. File ingest + refresh bug fix

### 7.1 Ingest kinds

| Kind | Source | Persistence |
|---|---|---|
| `fsa` | Open Folder button (`showDirectoryPicker`) | handle in IDB → re-granted silently on reload |
| `fsa` via drop | **New:** drag-drop a folder; `DataTransferItem.getAsFileSystemHandle()` returns a persistent handle → treated like Open Folder | handle in IDB → re-granted on reload |
| `drop` (fallback) | Drag-drop without handle API (old Chrome / loose files) | snapshot content stored in IDB, no live refresh |
| `intercept` | `file://` URL opened in Chrome → content script rewrites → our tab loads it | sourceUrl fetched each view |

### 7.2 The refresh bug + fix

**Bug:** dropped folders used `webkitGetAsEntry()` → snapshot-only;
reloading didn't reflect disk edits; user had to re-drop.

**Fix:** `DropZone.tsx` now tries `DataTransferItem.getAsFileSystemHandle()`
first. If it returns a `FileSystemDirectoryHandle`, we call a new
`folderFromHandle()` helper in `fs.ts` (extracted from `pickFolder`):
persists the handle to IDB, walks the directory, registers session
handles, treats exactly like an Open Folder-sourced folder. Disk edits
flow back on every view.

**Limit:** loose single-file drops still snapshot — the Web API
doesn't give us a parent directory handle from a file item, and
filemark's store only knows folder handles. Workaround: drop the
parent folder.

---

## 8. Layout / styling rules (from `CLAUDE.md`)

- **Tailwind utilities first.** `.fv-*` classes reserved for
  rendered content that external libs own (react-markdown body, json
  viewer).
- **shadcn tokens only** — `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `border`,
  etc. No raw `bg-gray-900`.
- **Dark mode via `[data-theme="dark"]` attribute** on `<html>` using
  `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *))`
  — not a `.dark` class.
- **Package-local styles** stay in the package (Tailwind classes on
  JSX). Don't hoist into the host stylesheet.
- **Tailwind v4 needs explicit `@source`** to scan workspace pkgs.
  `apps/chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css` has:
  `@source "../../../../packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}"`. Without
  this, pkg-local utility classes silently vanish from the final CSS.

---

## 9. Interface contracts (`@filemark/core`)

```ts
interface ViewerProps {
  content: string;
  file: FileRef;
  storage?: StorageAdapter;
  assets?: AssetResolver;
  onNavigate?: (href: string) => void;
  trust?: "full" | "safe";
}

interface StorageAdapter {
  get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null>;
  set<T>(key: string, value: T): Promise<void>;
  delete(key: string): Promise<void>;
}

interface AssetResolver {
  resolve(relativePath: string): Promise<string | null>;
}
```

Each viewer pkg consumes these. Zero `chrome.*`, `vscode.*`, or Node
built-ins in `packages/**` — enforced by convention + linting.

---

## 10. Roadmap (condensed — full list in `docsi/ROADMAP.md`)

7 thematic pillars:
1. **Data** ✓ datagrid v1/v1.1/v1.2/v2 shipped; queued: streaming
   parse, xlsx export, image via AssetResolver, markdown-block,
   reference, geopoint.
2. **Form / capture** — `<Form>` MVP (field dispatch + persist), then
   stepper, quiz, poll.
3. **Tasks & organization** ✓ `TaskCheckbox` persistence; queued:
   cross-file task dashboard, kanban/timeline built on datagrid data
   layer.
4. **Reading UX** ✓ TOC; queued: presentation mode, outline, reading
   progress, split view.
5. **Knowledge graph** — backlinks, tag index, graph view, ⌘K
   command palette.
6. **Embeds & media** ✓ `SmartImage`; queued: gallery, safe-embed,
   Excalidraw.
7. **Tools & meta** ✓ full-text search; queued: ⌘K command palette,
   diff two .md, AI chat w/ doc context, writing stats.

Next proposed slice (from `ROADMAP.md` §9): task dashboard or form
MVP, then ⌘K. Waiting for user go-ahead.

---

## 11. Safety rules learned this session

- **Default to answering, not acting.** Questions / observations /
  "what if" ideations are discussion — not imperatives. Wait for an
  explicit verb ("add", "ship", "fix") before mutating files. Each
  new topic in a session needs its own green light; earlier
  "yes, go" doesn't carry over. (See `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` global rule
  and `memory/feedback_ask_before_acting.md`.)
- **Don't include Claude/AI/Anthropic in commit messages**, no
  Co-Authored-By lines.
- **Never commit / push without explicit "commit" / "push"**, each
  time.
- **Tailwind pkg sources must be `@source`'d** from the host — was a
  real footgun earlier this session (all hover/resize/border
  utilities silently missing from CSS until diagnosed).
- **MV3 CSP is load-bearing** for many architectural choices — don't
  reach for eval, don't suggest MDX JSX, don't suggest inline script
  tags in dev.
